name: NOCTRA STUDIO
headline: Build Your Own AI Ecosystem.
tagline: YOUR AI. YOUR AGENTS. YOUR ECOSYSTEM.
shortDescription: A powerful desktop AI platform for building custom agents, connecting MCP servers, managing Skills, and orchestrating intelligent workflows.
overview: Engineered with Tauri 2, Rust, React, TypeScript, and SQLite, NOCTRA STUDIO runs locally on your computer with OS-backed credential storage, official MCP (2025-03-26) connectivity, GitHub Skills inspection, and a deterministic node-based Workflow Execution Engine.

features.title: Multi-Provider AI Engine
features.description: Configure OpenAI-compatible endpoints with SSE streaming, automatic JSON fallback, incremental tool-call assembly, and local attachments.

features.title: MCP Hub & Tool Explorer
features.description: Connect simultaneous stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP servers with health checks, JSON Schema validation, and resource/prompt inspection.

features.title: External MCP Integrations
features.description: Plug into official MCP registries, local filesystem/developer tools, and remote HTTP endpoints with filtered environments.

features.title: Agent Builder
features.description: Define agent identity, model overrides, assigned MCP tools, Skills, workspace path containment, and execution limits.

features.title: Skills Center & Marketplace
features.description: Author SKILL.md modules locally or discover packages via pluggable marketplace adapters with untrusted-by-default safeguards.

features.title: GitHub Skills Installation
features.description: Inspect repository trees, branches, commits, and SKILL.md files before installing—supporting files are never auto-executed.

features.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
features.description: Run sequential and parallel multi-agent pipelines with isolated agent memory and bounded recursion depth (maxAgentDepth).

features.title: Visual Workflow Builder
features.description: Design pausable, cancellable DAG workflows using Start, Input, AI Agent, MCP Tool, Skill, Conditional, Approval, Delay, Output, and End nodes.

features.title: Permission-Controlled Execution
features.description: Enforce Ask Every Time, Session, Always Allow, or Deny policies with interactive approval modals showing exact tool arguments and target paths.

features.title: Internet Mode & Security Scanner
features.description: Opt-in per-conversation Internet Mode with built-in Rust TCP port scanning, service banner grabbing, DNS lookup, HTTP/HTTPS security header audits, and SSRF/allowlist guardrails.

features.title: SSH Server Automation
features.description: Connect to remote Linux/Unix servers via password or SSH private key (stored in OS Keychain or session-only RAM) and let AI execute commands, inspect logs, and edit files automatically.

features.title: Browser Automation (/browser)
features.description: Trigger stateful web automation explicitly via /browser <URL> [task] so AI can inspect live UI elements, click buttons/links, type into inputs, fill forms, scroll, search pages, and extract structured data with mandatory approval for sensitive actions.

subsystems.name: AI Chat Engine
subsystems.summary: OpenAI-compatible HTTP + SSE client with Direct Chat Mode, Agent Mode, message branching/regeneration, and multimodal attachments.

subsystems.name: MCP Hub
subsystems.summary: Spec-compliant MCP 2025-03-26 JSON-RPC 2.0 client over stdio and Streamable HTTP with Mcp-Session-Id and redacted logs.

subsystems.name: Agent Runtime
subsystems.summary: Deterministic tool-filtering loop enforcing maxSteps, maxToolCalls, maxRuntimeSecs, and project path containment.

subsystems.name: Skills & Marketplace
subsystems.summary: SKILL.md YAML frontmatter + Markdown parser, GitHub repo/subdir inspector, ZIP/local importer, and catalog adapters.

subsystems.name: Workflow Engine
subsystems.summary: Live DAG executor with human-in-the-loop Approval gates, live timeline inspection, and persisted run history.

subsystems.name: Internet Mode & Security Diagnostics
subsystems.summary: Native async Rust TCP port scanner, DNS resolver, HTTP/HTTPS security header auditor, and safe URL fetcher with Review Mode approval gates and private-IP SSRF protection.

subsystems.name: SSH Remote Automation
subsystems.summary: Pure-Rust async SSH client (russh) with password/keyboard-interactive & private key authentication, TOFU host fingerprint verification, OS Keychain isolation, interactive terminal runner, and built-in AI tools (ssh_exec, ssh_read_file, ssh_write_file, ssh_list_dir, ssh_system_info).

subsystems.name: Browser Automation (/browser)
subsystems.summary: Stateful per-conversation browser automation engine triggered exclusively via /browser, providing cookie/history persistence, interactive UI element detection, clicking, typing, form filling/submission, scrolling, structured data extraction, CAPTCHA/login barrier detection, and mandatory confirmation for sensitive actions.

securityModel: Untrusted by default: external GitHub Skills, marketplace packages, and third-party MCP servers are flagged unverified until explicitly trusted.
No automatic script execution: Skill scripts/ directories are indexed as metadata only and never run automatically.
OS-native credential storage via keyring (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service) plus SecretRedactor log scrubbing.
Canonicalized path containment keeps project file operations inside authorized root directories.
transmissionNotice: NOCTRA STUDIO runs locally with zero developer telemetry. When you invoke a cloud AI provider, remote Streamable HTTP MCP server, or fetch a GitHub Skill repository, requests are sent directly to those configured external endpoints.
